title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten named academic work environments at Pearson Library, each with a documented feature or access condition.

cards.title: Study Room 123
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · individual or small-group work
cards.notes: Reserve this 1–6-person room when you need a contained work session; use its PC, dry-erase board, monitor, and HDMI screen sharing.
cards.short_summary: A reservable small-group room with built-in presentation tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 123 holds 1–6 people and is one of Pearson Library's study rooms with a PC, dry-erase board, TV monitor, and HDMI cable.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, and staff; students have priority. Reserve during library hours and check in at the Circulation Desk with student ID.

cards.title: Study Room 124
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · individual or small-group work
cards.notes: Book this 1–6-person room for focused work or a compact project meeting, then connect a device to the monitor with the provided HDMI cable.
cards.short_summary: A small reservable room set up for shared screens and notes.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 124 holds 1–6 people and is one of Pearson Library's study rooms with a PC, dry-erase board, TV monitor, and HDMI cable.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, and staff; students have priority. Reservations are normally available in two-hour blocks during library hours.

cards.title: Study Room 125
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · individual or small-group work
cards.notes: Choose this 1–6-person room when a whiteboard and display will help organize a study plan; ask the Circulation Desk for markers or cables.
cards.short_summary: A reservable room pairing a whiteboard with screen-sharing hardware.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 125 holds 1–6 people and is one of Pearson Library's study rooms with a PC, dry-erase board, TV monitor, and HDMI cable.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, and staff; students have priority. Check in at the Circulation Desk and leave your ID for the booking.

cards.title: Study Room 126
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · individual or small-group work
cards.notes: Reserve this 1–6-person study room for a bounded work block, using its monitor and HDMI cable to review material together on one screen.
cards.short_summary: A compact, reservable study room with display equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 126 holds 1–6 people and is one of Pearson Library's study rooms with a PC, dry-erase board, TV monitor, and HDMI cable.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, and staff; students have priority. Reserve during regular library hours; longer bookings depend on availability.

cards.title: Conference Room 133
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · group meetings and presentations
cards.notes: Plan a larger project session here for 7–10 people; bring a laptop to share on the flat-screen display and use the dry-erase boards to map tasks.
cards.short_summary: A larger reservable collaboration room with display and whiteboard tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Conference Room 133 holds 7–10 people and has a PC, flat-screen monitor, wireless mouse and keyboard, HDMI, and dry-erase boards.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, and staff; faculty and staff have priority. Reserve during library hours and check in at the Circulation Desk.

cards.title: Conference Room 139
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · collaborative projects
cards.notes: Use this 5–8-person room for a presentation rehearsal or team review; its screen-sharing setup and dry-erase boards support visible group work.
cards.short_summary: A mid-sized, reservable room designed for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Conference Room 139 holds 5–8 people and has a PC, flat-screen monitor, wireless mouse and keyboard, HDMI, and dry-erase boards.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, and staff; faculty and staff have priority. Room reservations are available during regular library hours.

cards.title: Computer Lab 130
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · computer-based work
cards.notes: Reserve this lab when your work needs campus software or many desktop stations; it has 24 PCs, an instructor station with projector, and two dry-erase boards.
cards.short_summary: A technology-heavy room for individual or group computer work.
cards.evidence_claim: Pearson Library's computer lab includes 24 PC workstations, an instructor station with projector, two dry-erase boards, internet access, and specialized software.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, and staff; faculty and staff have priority. Reserve the room during library operating hours.

cards.title: Active Learning Classroom
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · instructor-reserved collaborative classroom
cards.notes: Use this space only with an instructor-led reservation: six movable tables support group configurations, and each table connects personal computers to a monitor.
cards.short_summary: A structured, technology-equipped room for class-based collaborative learning.
cards.evidence_claim: The Active Learning Classroom has six movable tables for groups, monitors at each desk, and an instructor station with computer and projector.
cards.source_title: Active Learning Classroom | Cal Lutheran Registrar
cards.access_notes: Located inside Pearson Library and bookable during library hours. An instructor must reserve it; it is locked when not in use, and food or drink is not permitted.

cards.entity_name: Elton and Janice Gallegly Center for Public Service and Civic Engagement
cards.title: Gallegly Center
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · study and collaboration area
cards.notes: Set up a collaborative session in the center's designated study area, then use the setting to focus a project on public service or civic engagement.
cards.short_summary: A library-based study and collaboration area within a civic-engagement center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elton and Janice Gallegly Center is located in Pearson Library and includes study and collaboration space.
cards.source_title: Location | Gallegly Center at Cal Lutheran
cards.access_notes: Located in Pearson Library. The university describes the center as a hub for nonpartisan thought leadership; confirm library building access requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Darling Collaboration Suite
cards.subtitle: Pearson Library · Writing Center location
cards.notes: Visit the Writing Center in this library suite to work through a draft or writing project; schedule through MyCLU Blackboard or stop by to arrange an appointment.
cards.short_summary: A named library suite that houses Cal Lutheran's Writing Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran identifies the Darling Collaboration Suite in Pearson Library as the location of its Writing Center and states that members of the Cal Lutheran community with a university email may use Writing Center services.
cards.source_title: Syllabus Policies | Academic Affairs at Cal Lutheran
cards.access_notes: Writing Center appointments are scheduled through the Writing Center tool in MyCLU Blackboard, or visitors may stop by the suite to schedule. University email access is stated for services.
